name: Skingrad Commemorative Coin

flavorText: Made of interlaced and colored strips of bark, the basket is a work of art in itself.
name: Braided Wood Elf Basket

flavorText: A wooden token good for a free drink at a winery you're pretty sure went out of business sometime before the Empire fell.
name: Free Wine Chit

flavorText: Once used by the ancient heartland elves. Clearly it has some sort of … writing? Sigils? Musical notation?
name: Worn Ayleid Tablet

title: Graht-Oak Carving
flavorText: This carving is of a wild elf figurine carved from a fallen branch of the mighty tree. It seems to be quietly breathing.
name: Graht-Oak Carving

title: Star-Gazer's Handkerchief
flavorText: A square of black silk embroidered with silver thread, this kerchief displays the night sky.
name: Star-Gazer's Handkerchief

title: Sacrificial Needles
flavorText: These long sharpened pins have hooked tips, used for unspeakable rites.
name: Sacrificial Needles

title: Spring-Loaded Lancets
flavorText: This is a set of simple tools are used for bloodletting. The spring mechanism guarantees cuts of equal depth.
name: Spring-Loaded Lancets

title: Bloody Worship Emblem
flavorText: This thin disk bears the symbol of Molag Bal, blood dripping from his pronounced fangs.
name: Bloody Worship Emblem

title: Scarification Blades
flavorText: A pair of thin knives used by vampires to mark their preferred prey.
name: Scarification Blades

title: Black Ram Plaque
flavorText: This small plaque is dedicated to the Black Ram incarnation of Hircine.
name: Black Ram Plaque

title: Salacious Meridian Statuette
flavorText: A provocative figurine of Meridia, Lady of Infinite Energies. Carved by an artisan with a vivid imagination.
name: Salacious Meridian Statuette

title: Five-Sided Die
flavorText: An irregular ivory die. Created by a follower of Sanguine, if the sigils acting as numbers are any indication.
name: Five-Sided Die

title: Imperial Tabula Game
flavorText: Tabula is a faster version of backgammon. The Imperial version lacks a doubling cube.
name: Imperial Tabula Game

title: Valenwood Dart Board
flavorText: A cork board, divided into segments. At  the center is a sketch of Javad Tharn punctured by many holes.
name: Valenwood Dart Board

title: Colovian Spirit Board
flavorText: Said to be used by Colovian nobles in communicating with the spirits of the dead. Or in an attempt to, anyway.
name: Colovian Spirit Board

title: Three Banners Triangle Chess Set
flavorText: Three-sided board for Triangle Chess, its pieces representing the Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, and Ebonheart Pact.
name: Three Banners Triangle Chess Set

title: Valenwood Knucklebones
flavorText: Used to cast lots and tell the future. Don't ask about their past.
name: Valenwood Knucklebones

title: Strid River Salt Wash
flavorText: This lotion is made with water from the Strid River, Gold Coast salts, and a time-honored West Weald concoction.
name: Strid River Salt Wash

title: Vintner's Hair Net
flavorText: Worn by workers in various vineyards, this white-silk woven net keeps the grapes free of contamination during pressing.
name: Vintner's Hair Net

title: Alderman's Mustache Comb
flavorText: Perfect for grooming facial hair. Comes with a packet of mustache wax
name: Alderman's Mustache Comb

title: Sword Saint's Trimmer
flavorText: Sold in Sentinel markets. A razor in the shape of a sword saint's blade with a foldable handle for travel.
name: Sword Saint's Trimmer

title: Julianos' Blessed Pomade
flavorText: A soapy gel once sold throughout West Weald. It has no magical properties, unless you count clever marketing.
name: Julianos' Blessed Pomade

title: Valente Hair Comb
flavorText: A wooden comb decorated with inlaid ivory grapes. Worn by growers who make their own wine on premises.
name: Valente Hair Comb

title: Vintage Vintner's Inkstand
flavorText: This crystal inkstand has room for two bottles of ink (red and black) and holders for multiple pens.
name: Vintage Vintner's Inkstand

title: Bleached Rag Stock Paper
flavorText: This is a ream of paper made from old clothes, producing heavy sheets that can be used for official documents.
name: Bleached Rag Stock Paper

title: Ebon Inlaid Shears
flavorText: These heavy scissors have blades made of black volcanic glass, and can cut through metal and tile with ease.
name: Ebon Inlaid Shears

title: Battlehorn Bookmark
flavorText: A thin strip of pressed gold, embossed with the symbol of a Battlehorn winery, used as a promotion.
name: Battlehorn Bookmark

title: Calligrapher's Dip Pen
flavorText: Plucked from the wings of a swan, this is the perfect pen to record one's innermost thoughts.
name: Calligrapher's Dip Pen

title: Reversible Account Book
flavorText: This bound volume records winery accounts, and can then can be flipped over to mark down real expenditures. Clever.
name: Reversible Account Book

title: Colovian Whistle Spoon
flavorText: This maple ladle has a hollow handle, making it useful both as a straw and a musical instrument.
name: Colovian Whistle Spoon

title: Set of Colmated Corks
flavorText: Made of cork oak bark and coated to provide a tight seal and a smooth opening.
name: Set of Colmated Corks

title: Valenwood Bone Needles
flavorText: The sharp points of these metal needles are used to extract marrow from the bones.
name: Valenwood Bone Needles

title: Legion Mess Kit
flavorText: Metal cup, plate, and frying pan with handle, once carried by Imperial forces on the march.
name: Legion Mess Kit

title: Wine Decanting Cradle
flavorText: Holds wine bottles in position for proper aeration. Carries the mark of House Valente.
name: Wine Decanting Cradle

title: Longhouse Corkscrew
flavorText: Likely made in commemoration of some event, the screw's wooden head portrays Emperor Moricar.
name: Longhouse Corkscrew

title: Werehunter's Collar
flavorText: A collar for a large dog or wolf. Stamped with the personal sigil of Songamdir, Packmaster to Hircine.
name: Werehunter's Collar

title: Imperial Chewtoy
flavorText: A badly-mangled doll, it bears a passing resemblance to a now-dead emperor.
name: Imperial Chewtoy

title: Werewolf Tail Scarf
flavorText: A handsomely knitted scarf with a leather cinch. Perfect for accentuating your tail at the next pack do.
name: Werewolf Tail Scarf

title: Emblem of Vykosa
flavorText: A disk embossed with the symbol of Vykosa the Ascendant, a relic of her notorious pack.
name: Emblem of Vykosa

title: Heart-leather Wristwrap
flavorText: The keepsake of a successful hunt. This accessory was made from the cured heart of a hated foe.
name: Heart-leather Wristwrap

title: Screamy Bone
flavorText: A magically enchanted femur, when chewed, produces hideous and creative illusory screams.
name: Screamy Bone

title: Automatic Cork Borer
flavorText: Such devices are suitable for piercing particularly troublesome bottles. Stamped by a Summerset tinker.
name: Automatic Cork Borer

title: High Elven Wine Pourer
flavorText: Stamped by a Summerset tinker, this device uses a scale to measure the weight of your glass and pour to make up the difference.
name: High Elven Wine Pourer

title: Clockwork Aroma Dispenser
flavorText: This small glass and copper device emits jets of perfumed air every three minutes or so.
name: Clockwork Aroma Dispenser

title: Wood Elf Wind Chimes
flavorText: Made with hollow bones strung on copper wine, these small chimes create a pleasant if spooky noise in the breeze.
name: Wood Elf Wind Chimes

title: Clockwork Emperor
flavorText: A wind-up doll fashioned to look like Emperor Leovic. Can walk across the floor and salute.
name: Clockwork Emperor

title: Archivist's Doodlebug
flavorText: Stamped by a Summerset tinker. When loaded with ink this beetle-shaped device wanders across a page, making notations.
name: Archivist's Doodlebug

title: Skooma Goblet
flavorText: Bearing lunar imagery and an interesting internal reservoir, the design suggests it's used for drinks mixed with skooma.
name: Skooma Goblet

title: Moon-Sugar Tongs
flavorText: These ornate tongs can easily grasp moon-sugar crystals. They are covered in a powdery substance.
name: Moon-Sugar Tongs

title: Smuggler's Handkerchief
flavorText: The wrinkles and residue on this once-fine handkerchief suggest it was used as an improvised skooma bag at some point.
name: Smuggler's Handkerchief

title: Wine Bottle Skooma Case
flavorText: Cleverly fashioned like a West Weald wine bottle, this skooma case has a false bottom that's easy to disguise.
name: Wine Bottle Skooma Case

title: West Weald Sugar Pipe
flavorText: Engraved with grapes and swords, common symbols of West Weald, and likely fashioned by a soldier on the march.
name: West Weald Sugar Pipe

title: Colovian Compact Mirror
flavorText: This compact pocket mirror once held powder, but has clearly been used more recently to smuggle skooma.
name: Colovian Compact Mirror

title: Toy Legion Sword
flavorText: This blunt wooden sword is the perfect size for children to make trouble with.
name: Toy Legion Sword

title: Painted Julianos Abacus
flavorText: This brightly painted abacus is used to introduce children to the divine logic and teachings of Julianos.
name: Painted Julianos Abacus

title: Practice Legion Bugle
flavorText: Shiny and scaled for little hands, this toy bugle inspires loyalty in children and rage in their parents.
name: Practice Legion Bugle

title: Legion Officer Figurine
flavorText: Intricately crafted, every detail on this toy legionary has been accounted for, from its crested helmet to its tiny sword.
name: Legion Officer Figurine

title: Wooden Puzzle Box
flavorText: This ornate box includes carved vines that cleverly hide the mechanism to open it. Perfect for hiding treats from prying eyes.
name: Wooden Puzzle Box

title: Colovian Pretending Steed
flavorText: This children's toy exemplifies local craftsmanship, with a soft woven mane and sturdy stick for playing.
name: Colovian Pretending Steed

title: Vashabar Wine Decanter
flavorText: Some Wood Elves embrace the wine culture of Colovia, as evidenced by this metal decanter.
name: Vashabar Wine Decanter

title: Leather Travel Dishes
flavorText: Fashioned of boiled leather, these travel dishes are lightweight and easily packed away by Wood Elves on the move.
name: Leather Travel Dishes

title: Leather Place Mats
flavorText: Most Wood Elf meals are simple affairs, but when the occasion calls for it, these place mats add a bit of decorum.
name: Leather Place Mats

title: Metal Simmer Cauldron
flavorText: This large metal cauldron could easily hold the meat of a whole roast boar.
name: Metal Simmer Cauldron

title: Large Soup Spoon
flavorText: This oversized metal spoon could only reasonably be used for stirring soup in a cauldron big enough to feed a whole clan.
name: Large Soup Spoon

title: Ceremonial Skewers
flavorText: These extra-long metal skewers are used by Wood Elves to roast a hunter's first kill before sharing with the clan.
name: Ceremonial Skewers

title: Legion Helm Replacement Plume
flavorText: When a legionary's distinctive fur plume thins out due to time or damage, this replacement keeps them looking sharp.
name: Legion Helm Replacement Plume

title: Iron Manacles
flavorText: A set of wrist manacles used by guards in Skingrad to detain prisoners and suspects.
name: Iron Manacles

title: Citation Ledger
flavorText: Many low-ranking city guards carry these ledgers to record minor infractions and petty crimes.
name: Citation Ledger

title: West Weald Emblem
flavorText: This small emblem bears the count's crest and serves as a mark of authority for Skingrad guards.
name: West Weald Emblem

title: Ceremonial Armor Polish
flavorText: Only to be used before important court events, this polish imbues a high sheen to armor that lasts for hours.
name: Ceremonial Armor Polish

title: Decorative Skingrad Scabbard
flavorText: High-ranking Legion officers are awarded these decorative scabbards to acknowledge their loyalty and service.
name: Decorative Skingrad Scabbard

title: Mastiff Collar
flavorText: An extra large and sturdy collar, the perfect size for a cherished West Weald mastiff.
name: Mastiff Collar

title: Vineyard Dowel
flavorText: These wooden dowels are commonly used across West Weald to direct the growth of grape vines.
name: Vineyard Dowel

title: Jar of Corks
flavorText: This jar full of wine corks is nearly full. Judging by the smell, the corks have all been used.
name: Jar of Corks

title: Colovian Spade
flavorText: A well-made spade, with a carved wooden handle featuring a vine motif.
name: Colovian Spade

title: Colovian Wine Press
flavorText: Smaller than the presses used by vineyards, this wine press is perfect for making small personal batches.
name: Colovian Wine Press

title: Silver Corkscrew
flavorText: This shiny corkscrew has been lovingly maintained. It might even make the wine taste better.
name: Silver Corkscrew

title: Skingrad Cloak Pin
flavorText: This iron cloak pin resembles a blade and grape vine, making it a stylish way to keep cloaks and capes in place.
name: Skingrad Cloak Pin

title: Sword Hairpin
flavorText: Shaped like a tiny sword, this hairpin is fiercely fashionable and could be good for poking an eye out in a pinch.
name: Sword Hairpin

title: Polished Belt Buckle
flavorText: Despite the gleam on this buckle, there are a few tell-tale knicks from heavy use.
name: Polished Belt Buckle

title: Colovian Cufflinks
flavorText: Wine is everywhere in Colovia. Even these tiny cufflinks resemble small bunches of grapes.
name: Colovian Cufflinks

title: Julianos Prayer Shawl
flavorText: This fine shawl is woven with images of Julianos, as well as complex repeating patterns that draw the eye.
name: Julianos Prayer Shawl

title: Silver Comb
flavorText: Lovingly cared for, this delicate comb has been polished to a high shine.
name: Silver Comb

title: Jar of Grave Dirt
flavorText: The soil of West Weald is particularly fertile, making for soft and enviable graves.
name: Jar of Grave Dirt

title: Fang Sharpening Kit
flavorText: This wicked-looking device can be fitted over fangs to shave them down to a terrifying point.
name: Fang Sharpening Kit

title: Skeletal Goblet
flavorText: The clean ivory appearance of this goblet belies its bloody origins.
name: Skeletal Goblet

title: Weald Vintage Blood Port
flavorText: A delicacy among local vampires. The scarlet liquid within easily passes for a simple bottle of wine.
name: Weald Vintage Blood Port

title: Bronzed Bat Wing
flavorText: This bizarre curio appears to be a superstitious token, though it's impossible to tell if it's good luck or bad.
name: Bronzed Bat Wing

title: Partial Cemetery Guide
flavorText: A page from a guidebook about West Weald gravesites. A large red stain obscures much of the writing.
name: Partial Cemetery Guide

title: Vine of the Weald
flavorText: These precious tokens are purportedly bestowed by the count himself, for outstanding service in the Legion of West Weald.
name: Vine of the Weald

title: Ghastly Goblin Masker
flavorText: A bottle of clear, odorless green liquid that's supposedly said to mask one's scent from goblins. Popular amongst parents.
name: Ghastly Goblin Masker

title: Wine's Wisp Perfume
flavorText: Concocted by Skingrad's finest wineries. One free with every bottle of wine purchased.
name: Wine's Wisp Perfume

title: Cooling Claypot Lotion
flavorText: Bottled in small, pocket-sized clay pots. Carried by travelers who are frequently exposed to the brunt of the Alik'r sun.
name: Cooling Claypot Lotion

title: Moonlight Powder
flavorText: A powder that resembles the faded complexion of a vampire. For when dinner gets a bit too bloody messy.
name: Moonlight Powder

title: Cheese Pleaser
flavorText: A cologne crafted from Skingrad's finest cheeses. Keep sealed and away from rodents.
name: Cheese Pleaser

title: Sanguine Smile
flavorText: A small pot of balm made from human blood, perfect for your next formal occasion.
name: Sanguine Smile

title: Dibella Lily Charm
flavorText: The Mark of the Order of the Lily. Carries both the shape and scent of the flower, with a Dibella crest at its center.
name: Dibella Lily Charm

title: Sacramental Wine Goblet
flavorText: Used by temples and monasteries across West Weald. Filled with wine from only Skingrad's finest vineyards.
name: Sacramental Wine Goblet

title: Book of Logic
flavorText: A prayer book of sorts used by Julianos followers. Inscribed are quotes from prominent scholars and even Psijic sages.
name: Book of Logic

title: Kynareth Shrine Votive
flavorText: Prayer beads to Kynareth embedded in this candle's wax allow the flame to flicker on even when left outside in the rain.
name: Kynareth Shrine Votive

title: Tears of the Queen Ewer
flavorText: Fashioned and blessed by high priests of Kynareth, collects only pure rainwater for absolution rites.
name: Tears of the Queen Ewer

title: Periapt of Bloodlines
flavorText: The preserved fingers and toes of the deceased are strung together with string in commemoration.
name: Periapt of Bloodlines

title: Hegathe Flask
flavorText: A copper flask meant to keep water cool under hot Hammerfell skies.
name: Hegathe Flask

title: Traditional Rotmeth Mug
flavorText: A wooden mug emblazoned with a Green Pact symbol, which explains the dried blood in it.
name: Traditional Rotmeth Mug

title: Colovian Timber Mug
flavorText: The scent of Colovia's rich timber is said to further enrich any liquid poured into it. Particularly wine.
name: Colovian Timber Mug

title: Caelum Vineyard Bottle
flavorText: One of the very few wine bottles recovered from Caelum Vineyard after a terrible fire burned the winery, and its owner, to ash.
name: Caelum Vineyard Bottle

title: Olroy Cheese Wine
flavorText: A few only ever made it into distribution. The smell alone can cause intense gagging.
name: Olroy Cheese Wine

title: Rislav Commemorative Wine Bottle
flavorText: From the celebration of Rislav's crowning as King. The bottle's glass purportedly bears his signature, etched with a dagger.
name: Rislav Commemorative Wine Bottle

title: Tooth Hook Fishing Tackle
flavorText: Carved from bones and teeth. Crafted by a Wood Elf with a grudge.
name: Tooth Hook Fishing Tackle

title: Oasis Fishing Guide
flavorText: Sold by unscrupulous merchants to mislead travelers. Filled with claims of a stocked fishing hole amid the desert sands.
name: Oasis Fishing Guide

title: Novelty Maze Cheese Hook
flavorText: A block of Breton Maze Cheese intricately carved from wood, with a fish hook coming out of one of the holes on the bottom.
name: Novelty Maze Cheese Hook

title: Sweetberry Fish Goop
flavorText: Grown and mashed to attract any sea critter with a sweet tooth. To be smeared on a fish hook, not eaten.
name: Sweetberry Fish Goop

title: Valenwood Vine Net
flavorText: Bones, chiseled until sharpened, protrude from the sturdy vines of this intricately crafted Wood Elf fishing net.
name: Valenwood Vine Net

title: Logical Fishing Apparatus
flavorText: Crafted by ingenious students of Julianos, this can be jury-rigged to a rod to reel itself in at the moment it hooks a fish.
name: Logical Fishing Apparatus

title: Lullaby Sheet Music for Goblins
flavorText: Music is universal, or so thought the late composer of this kalimba tune.
name: Lullaby Sheet Music for Goblins

title: Alik'r Flurry Flute
flavorText: Optimistically thought to release twice the amount of wind, cooling listeners. Requires skillful playing from its musician.
name: Alik'r Flurry Flute

title: Legion's March Music-maker
flavorText: A wooden recorder popular among children who want to join the Legion's ranks.
name: Legion's March Music-maker

title: Silver n' Bone Kalimba
flavorText: Silver pieces are lodged in the polished bones that act as this Kalimba's tines.
name: Silver n' Bone Kalimba

title: Singer's Bagpipe
flavorText: A bagpipe filled with colorful living insects that fly and encircle the musician as they play.
name: Singer's Bagpipe

title: Grape-growers Wind Chimes
flavorText: Hung by vintners in their fields. Said to help the grapes grow faster thanks to the tones of these specially tuned bronze pipes.
name: Grape-growers Wind Chimes

title: Empty Legionaire's Armor Kit
flavorText: This kit was created to include everything you'd need to bang out dents in your armor in the field.
name: Empty Legionaire's Armor Kit

title: Blacksmith's Rat Stamper
flavorText: Specially crafted by a fed up Legionary smith, this flat-prowed instrument has seen a lot of use.
name: Blacksmith's Rat Stamper

title: Colovian Timber Saw
flavorText: Used by Colovian woodcutters to fell the choicest timber without destroying the good parts.
name: Colovian Timber Saw

title: Tutor's Whetstone
flavorText: Touched by minor enchantments, this whetstone teaches proper technique by glowing red once the sword is sufficiently sharp.
name: Tutor's Whetstone

title: Crushed Thunderbug Paste
flavorText: A Valenwood export that supposedly results in shocking arrows. Apply with care.
name: Crushed Thunderbug Paste

title: Generational Axe Set
flavorText: A family's leather folding case full of hand-axes. Each has oils and a whetstone folded in for care.
name: Generational Axe Set

title: Imperial Legion Squire's Badge
flavorText: A wooden badge given to children who want to be a Legionary for the day.
name: Imperial Legion Squire's Badge

title: Shoddy Drinks List
flavorText: A scrawled paper listing wines and ales enjoyed or not. It almost reads as if the person writing this was drunk.
name: Shoddy Drinks List

title: Thieves Hit List
flavorText: A how-to tract highlighting the types of people best to rob on the roads around Skingrad. Drunks is underlined three times.
name: Thieves Hit List

title: Rislav Goblin Doll Wanted Poster
flavorText: A poster demanding knowledge of whoever's responsible for the distribution of Righteous Rislav dolls resewn with goblin heads.
name: Rislav Goblin Doll Wanted Poster

title: Wine Tasting Invitation
flavorText: An invitation to esteemed vineyard owners across West Weald to participate in a wine tasting event in Sutch.
name: Wine Tasting Invitation

title: Yours for the Taking Handbill
flavorText: Faded and torn, this handbill written by Catonius Libo promises fortune and opportunity in the sacking of Arenthia.
name: Yours for the Taking Handbill

title: Wild Hunt Serenity Scroll
flavorText: This fragile animal skin holds an ancient spinner's ritual said to allow a Wood Elf a return after summoning the Wild Hunt.
name: Wild Hunt Serenity Scroll

title: Rislav Larich Model Statue
flavorText: A detailed model of the legendary statue of Rislav Larich, Rislav the Righteous, kissed by Kynareth and beloved by Colovians.
name: Rislav Larich Model Statue

title: Mages Guild Bear Doll
flavorText: A white-furred children's toy dressed in the blue armor of a Mages Guild adept.
name: Mages Guild Bear Doll

title: Righteous Rislav Doll
flavorText: This children's doll of one of Skingrad's rulers comes with its own sword made from local Colovian oak.
name: Righteous Rislav Doll

title: Fighters Guild Bear Doll
flavorText: A brown-furred children's toy dressed in the red armor of a Fighters Guild warrior.
name: Fighters Guild Bear Doll

title: Kynareth Songbird Doll
flavorText: Made with blue, red, and green felt, soft as a newborn's embrace. For good fortune from the Divine herself.
name: Kynareth Songbird Doll

title: Thieves Guild Bear Doll
flavorText: A dark-furred children's toy dressed in the somber leather armor of a Thieves Guild pickpocket.
name: Thieves Guild Bear Doll

title: Undaunted Guild Bear Doll
flavorText: An orange-furred children's toy dressed in the heavy (wooden) armor of the Undaunted. They are undaunted.
name: Undaunted Guild Bear Doll

title: Unstuffed Skingrad Flag Pillow
flavorText: Someone's gone to the trouble of making a Skingrad flag into a pillow sleeve. Just needs stuffing to look good upon a divan.
name: Unstuffed Skingrad Flag Pillow

title: Amateur's Doily
flavorText: A first try at knitting a proper doily. The erstwhile student appears to have gotten bored halfway through.
name: Amateur's Doily

title: Julianos Deity Doily
flavorText: A doily with the symbol of Julianos worked into the center. Meticulously crafted in veneration to the god of logic.
name: Julianos Deity Doily

title: Deerskin Singer's Blanket
flavorText: A blanket stitched with fine deer skin. Has been carefully worked all along the edges with symbols in veneration to Y'ffre.
name: Deerskin Singer's Blanket

title: Rich Red Silk Tablecloth
flavorText: A silk tablecloth embroidered with gold thread.
name: Rich Red Silk Tablecloth

title: Everlasting Slumber Pillow
flavorText: A pillow fashioned with a waterskin in the center, in hopes it will stay cool overnight.
name: Everlasting Slumber Pillow

title: Tattered Ink-Stained Script
flavorText: A now illegible scrap of vellum once used by a first era magical discipline.
name: Tattered Ink-Stained Script

title: Ulfsild the Evergreen Effigy
flavorText: A carved wooden statue revering a Skyrim hedge witch popular for her teaching and power in the first era.
name: Ulfsild the Evergreen Effigy

title: Crude Netch Carving
flavorText: A rune-inscribed statue in the shape of a Netch, seemingly carved with its tentacles widely gesturing.
name: Crude Netch Carving

title: Wooden Thumb
flavorText: This stone releases scents of fresh ash, oak, or timber when next to a tree ripe for cutting.
name: Wooden Thumb

title: Hunting Grounds Periapt
flavorText: A piece of onyx carved into the shape of a fox with curiously kind eyes and a smile.
name: Hunting Grounds Periapt

title: Charred Grimoire Husk
flavorText: A mystical tome once utilized by a first era magical discipline. Any power within was consumed by a failed experiment.
name: Charred Grimoire Husk

title: Vintage Graht-Oak Sap
flavorText: A tall clay jar of sap fermented beneath Valenwood's graht-oak trees. Delicious, aids in digestive issues, and clears the skin.
name: Vintage Graht-Oak Sap

title: Sutch Salve
flavorText: A popular local ointment for the everyday cuts and bruises a commoner might receive working their daily tasks.
name: Sutch Salve

title: Hearty Soup Pills
flavorText: Simple herbal remedies meant to be added to a working lunch. Favored by sickly woodcutters.
name: Hearty Soup Pills

title: Baan Dar's Drops
flavorText: A tincture said to allow for immaculate archery precision. Favored by the Vinedusk Rangers.
name: Baan Dar's Drops

title: Thassad's Flavored Oil
flavorText: Said to be favored by the great merchant Pranak Thassad of Sentinel. Used vigorously on his hair and beard, and as an evening beverage.
name: Thassad's Flavored Oil

title: Love's Restoration
flavorText: An elixir blessed and blended by Dibellan worshippers. Said to restore lost love, whether for yourself or another.
name: Love's Restoration

title: Bloody Wine Vintage
flavorText: Supposedly corked and bottled near Skingrad, this is a potent mixture of wine and thickening blood.
name: Bloody Wine Vintage

title: Preserved Warhorse Leg
flavorText: The lower leg of a once-prized warhorse ridden by a Skingrad noble. A conversation piece.
name: Preserved Warhorse Leg

title: Finger File
flavorText: A severed finger with a sharp nail that continues to grow. Used by some Wood Elves to file their teeth.
name: Finger File

title: Valenwood Quicklime Satchel
flavorText: This treated bag holds a quantity of quicklime sufficient to return a few bodies back to the Green.
name: Valenwood Quicklime Satchel

title: Highland Soldier Emblem
flavorText: A tarnished badge left behind by one of the soldiers that set out to claim the Arenthia Vale.
name: Highland Soldier Emblem

title: Resewn Rislav Doll
flavorText: A Righteous Rislav doll resewn with a cloth goblin's head.
name: Resewn Rislav Doll

title: Grateful Mentor Idol
flavorText: Carved by followers of Julianos to show their respect. Given to the teacher that made the biggest impression on the student.
name: Grateful Mentor Idol

title: Lucky Silver Coin
flavorText: At first glance a normal silver coin. It's been carefully weighted to always land heads: the raven symbol of Nocturnal.
name: Lucky Silver Coin

title: Stendarr Effigy
flavorText: An simple clay effigy of one of Stendarr. Passed to those who seek mercy from any pain that ails them.
name: Stendarr Effigy

title: Guidance of the Green
flavorText: A straw swan filled with torchbugs to glow in the dark. To help guide through the Green.
name: Guidance of the Green

title: Shehai Worrystone
flavorText: One of a series of small worrystones made by an artisan that witnessed Sai Sahan summon his own spirit sword.
name: Shehai Worrystone

title: Bark of Brackenleaf
flavorText: A piece of bark from one of Valenwood's first trees. When held to the ear, a true devout to the Green can hear Valenwood speak.
name: Bark of Brackenleaf

title: Jar of Repulsive Goblin Toenails
flavorText: One Goblin's toenail is another's treasure. Neatly stacked and sealed for a purpose only its collector knows.
name: Jar of Repulsive Goblin Toenails

title: Bird Skeleton in a Cage
flavorText: A tiny brass cage with a little swing upon which a small bird's skeleton has been wired in place.
name: Bird Skeleton in a Cage

title: Sealed Imperial Banking Ink
flavorText: A small pot of ink sealed with a faded sigil of the Empire, this was once used exclusively by bankers in Imperial City.
name: Sealed Imperial Banking Ink

title: Horsemaster's Symbol of Prowess
flavorText: A badge of a bronze, galloping horse. Given to students upon graduation from a now defunct Imperial academy.
name: Horsemaster's Symbol of Prowess

title: Crimson Scarf with Heart Badge
flavorText: A mother's love runs through every fiber. Knitted to shield her child from the brisk cold of the Colovian forests.
name: Crimson Scarf with Heart Badge

title: Swimming Horse-Ship Model
flavorText: A fanciful model, made to the rough description of the ships that helped the Redguard flee Yokuda.
name: Swimming Horse-Ship Model

title: Horn of Emperor Brazollus Dor
flavorText: One of the many horns Emperor Brazollus Dor used to lead his army, one of the few responsibilities he enjoyed.
name: Horn of Emperor Brazollus Dor

title: Dormant Vashabar Seedpod
flavorText: A nascent seedpod that, if properly cultivated by a Greenspeaker, could one day grow into a Wood Elf podhome.
name: Dormant Vashabar Seedpod

title: West Weald Writings
flavorText: A mysterious tome containing all of the books in the West Weald Writings collection.
name: West Weald Writings

title: Scholarium Scribblings
flavorText: A mysterious tome containing all of the books in the Scholarium Scribblings collection.
name: Scholarium Scribblings

title: Survey Reports - West Weald
flavorText: A compendium of every survey report recorded in West Weald.
name: Survey Reports - West Weald

title: Test Ink Box
flavorText: Test Ink Box
name: Test Ink Box

title: Handbook for New Homeowners
flavorText: A handy all-in-one reference for new homeowners.
name: Handbook for New Homeowners

title: Mystery Transformation Verse
abilityDescription:
Grants one inactive Transformation Verse from Mora's Boons.

The scroll is only usable in Infinite Archive and is limited to a single use per Archive run.
flavorText: This scroll holds an unknown Transformation Verse for use in the Infinite Archive. The three unique Visions from each set are not required.
name: Mystery Transformation Verse
